domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 利用等效确定性激励求取随机振动频域响应的方法。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道等系统的线性或线性化随机振动分析中，构造与随机激励谱对应的确定性复谐波虚拟激励，以求取响应功率谱、减少随机样本计算，也可作为频域分析结果的比较基准。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P017.title: A spectral evolution model for track geometric degradation in train–track long-term dynamics
P017.label: Xu等（2020）

complete_examples.text: By simplifying into a linearized model, pseudo-excitation method (PEM) can be theoretically implemented to characterize the dominant vibration frequencies of vehicle-track systems due to random excitations.
Pseudo-excitation method proposed by Lin et al. [35] is a highly efficient algorithm for structural stationary/nonstationary random analysis.

Besides a systematic framework integrating the train–track dynamic model, track irregularity PSD evolution model and the Pseudo-excitation method is developed to predict the uncertain responses of system components long-termly.

Apart from predicting the long-term evolution of track irregularity amplitude and the track quality index, the PSD evolution model can be perfectly united with the train–track interaction model and a pseudo-excitation method to reveal the long-term evolution of system behaviours no matter on response amplitudes or on their characteristic frequencies against different confidence intervals.
